Any non-ASCII character (e.g. "é", "í", "Å") is silently dropped before the CSV is parsed, so "José Martínez" becomes "Jos Martnez". This is data loss, not a decoding/mojibake problem. The line is unnecessary for the parser (csv.DictReader handles Unicode str fine) and should be removed or replaced with a non-lossy approach (e.g. handle bytes input with UTF-8 decoding at the file-reading boundary, not by stripping characters).
